phase_title: Badge value allowlist and badge size/position (v1.1)

acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: A configured allowlist restricts rendering to the listed values.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeDefinitionResolver.cs:54-76 filters each resolved pre-template value (and the fixed UpgradePending status text) against definition.AllowedValues before applying the definition template.
src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeSelectorResolver.cs:110-130 IsAllowed performs a case-insensitive ordinal exact match of the trimmed value; no substring/wildcard/prefix/regex.

tests/ArrTags.Tests/BadgeAllowlistFilterTests.cs (8 unguarded cases) covers exact/case-insensitive match, trim + partial-match rejection, per-retained CustomBadge value, the full Audio composite, UpgradePending, filter-before-template, and unknown/absent omission.

Test-quality mutation evidence (docs/implementation/12.2/test-quality-review.json) independently killed always-allow, substring, case-sensitive, filter-after-template, and status-path-filter-removed mutants.

acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: The allowlist is bounded, validated at configuration load, and secret-free.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Configuration/RendererConfiguration.cs:180-229 ValidateAllowedValues enforces <=32 entries (BadgeDefinition.MaximumAllowedValues), <=64 chars each (MaximumAllowedValueLength), trims entries, and rejects blank/control-character/case-insensitive-duplicate entries.
src/ArrTags/Configuration/PluginConfigurationValidator.cs:35 invokes RendererConfiguration.Validate at configuration load.
Validation messages include only the selector name and the bound, never the configured value (secret-free).

src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeDefinition.cs:173-232 defensively re-enforces the same bounds on the resolved snapshot; RendererConfigurationResolver.TryCreateDefinition (118-133) falls back to the code-owned default for an unvalidated candidate.

acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: Unknown/absent values remain omitted; an empty allowlist means no restriction.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeSelectorResolver.cs:115-118 returns true for an empty allowlist (no restriction).
tests/ArrTags.Tests/BadgeAllowlistFilterTests.cs EmptyAllowlistMeansNoRestriction and UnknownAndAbsentValuesRemainOmittedWithAnAllowlist.
The filter can only remove an already-confirmed value and never widens an omission (it is applied after value resolution, never before).

acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: A configured size and anchor (four corners plus center) affect the rendered badge.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgePosition.cs and BadgeSize.cs define the five anchors and three presets; RendererConfigurationResolver.ResolveOutputPolicy carries them onto RenderOutputPolicy (79-80, 90-104).
src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeGeometry.cs:151-169 ComputeEffectiveScale = clamp(width/1000,0.5,4.0)*sizeFactor (0.75/1.0/1.5) with the safe-area clamp.
tests/ArrTags.Tests/BadgeSizePositionTests.cs (48 cases) asserts absolute per-anchor coordinates and each preset scale; test-quality mutations M1/M3/M6/M8 fail.

Four new pixel-level goldens pin non-default placement/size (top-left, top-right-large, bottom-right-small, center); forced-native RenderGoldenTests passes 35/1/36 and the new top-left.png differs from the default rgb-png.png.

acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: Rail packing, status-pill placement, and safe-area bounds are defined per anchor; no badge paints outside the safe area.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeLayoutEngine.cs:48-131, 277-310 positions the rail per anchor (stack away from the anchored edge, align to the anchored side) and places the status pill top-right except TopRight->top-left (312-357).
Top-anchor first-row reservation (79-87) and bottom/Center status-band row reduction (88-106) prevent rail/status overlap.

tests/ArrTags.Tests/BadgeSizePositionTests.cs NoPillPaintsOutsideTheSafeAreaOnNarrowAndShortPosters asserts every pill lies inside the scaled inset for all 5 anchors x 3 sizes x 6 dimensions, including 1000x150 and 240x600.

TQ-12.3-01 (top-anchor reservation) and TQ-12.3-03 (Center status band) were resolved in worker attempt 4 with non-vacuous wide-pill and short-Center tests (TopAnchorsReserveTheFirstRowForAWideStatusBand, CenterAnchorStatusBandDropsTheRowsThatWouldStartInsideIt).

acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: The change is output-affecting: the fingerprint changes, RenderVersion advances, and the goldens are regenerated.
evidence: RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion 1->2 and RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion 2->3 are the only advanced version values (BadgeMetadata.CurrentSchemaVersion stays 2; StateEnvelopeCodec.CurrentSchemaVersion stays 1).

RendererConfigurationFingerprint includes a non-empty resolved allowlist (normalized) and a non-default position/size; RenderFingerprint.ComputeOutputFingerprint hashes rendererVersion, badgeSchemaVersion, configurationFingerprint, and a non-default placement.

manifest.json: 9 existing entries changed only OutputFingerprint (OutputHash byte-identical to pre-task HEAD) and 4 new anchor/size entries added; all 13 committed PNGs reproduce byte- and fingerprint-identical under the forced-native renderer (35/1/36).

No writer/auto-approval path exists in the golden tests (writer scan clean; the determinism probe writes only to its env temp path); mutating a golden byte or a manifest OutputFingerprint fails RenderGoldenTests closed.

findings.summary: The absolute default output/configuration-fingerprint pin lives only in the native-guarded golden path. An unconditional AppendBadgePlacement mutation (or any regression that changes the default fingerprint) leaves the default ./build.sh test suite green; only the forced-native RenderGoldenTests catches it. This is a default-suite test-strength gap, not a correctness defect: production is identity-neutral by construction (AppendBadgePlacement appends nothing for BottomLeft/Medium) and the committed manifest OutputFingerprint values are absolutely pinned by the forced-native run.
evidence: docs/implementation/12.3/test-quality-review.json TQ-12.3-02 mutation M4b -> default suite Failed 0, Passed 1490
docs/implementation/12.4/test-quality-review.json TQ-12.4-01 mutation F2 -> default suite green; forced-native RenderGoldenTests Failed 11, Passed 4, Total 15
tests/ArrTags.Tests/RenderGoldenTests.cs:30-75 ([SkiaNativeTheory]) is the only absolute OutputFingerprint pin and is a single skip without ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1
tests/ArrTags.Tests/RenderFingerprintTests.cs and RendererConfigurationTests.cs assert only relative default==explicit-default equality
findings.recommended_action: Non-blocking for the phase gate (the forced-native golden run is part of the documented v1.1 verification matrix and is owned by task 14.3). To close the residual in the default suite, add a pure (no-Skia) test that computes the default ComputeOutputFingerprint/Compute for a committed golden fixture and asserts the exact committed Goldens/manifest.json value, and/or add the forced-native run to the documented release/verification checklist so it cannot be silently skipped.
